task: Open the very top drawer directly underneath the countertop on the right of the robot's starting position. This is the highest drawer in that stack, above every other drawer. Pulling out a lower drawer while the top drawer stays shut is failure. The target must finish open by roughly half its front-to-back depth. Holding the handle is allowed. The three synchronized views show the same scene. Use the clearest available view of the target; the drawer need not be visible in every view. Left/right refers to the robot at the start, not the current image edge.
